name: Split-Safety Palms (2-Read) Match
formation: Nickel Wide-9 Two-High vs 11P Gun 2x2 Smash
coverage: Cover 2 Palms (2-Read / Cloud Trap on #2 Out)

summary.motive: Obliterate standard Smash and quick-out concepts by using split-field 2-Read (Palms) matching, enabling the cornerback to trap underneath out routes while the safety caps deep corner routes.
summary.keyDefender: LCB (Palms flat trap corner) & SS (over-the-top corner cap safety)
summary.whyItWorks: Smash concepts are designed to stress standard Cover 2 or Cover 3, but Palms matches the routes in reverse: the corner takes the underneath out, and the safety takes the deep corner.
summary.failureMode: A double-vertical concept (4-Verticals) if the safety hesitates or gets occupied by a tight-end seam route.

beats.title: Split-Safety Palms Pre-Snap Alignment
beats.text: DeMeco Ryans shows a balanced two-high safety shell. Cornerbacks align at 6 yards with their eyes locked entirely on the inside #2 slot receivers, using Palms (2-Read) rules.

beats.title: 2-Read Key Triggers: #2 Breaks Out
beats.text: As slot receiver H breaks on an out route (the classic Smash concept), LCB reads the release, instantly abandons X, and drives aggressively downhill to trap the out route.

beats.title: Safety Rolls Over Top of Corner Route
beats.text: Simultaneously, SS sees #2 break out, opens his hips toward the sideline, and walls off X’s deep corner route from over the top, neutralizing the offense’s deep shot.

beats.title: LCB Intercepts Out Route for Pick-Six
beats.text: The QB throws the out route expecting single-high Cover 3 coverage, but LCB jumps the route with full momentum for an interception and touchdown return.

relations.tell: Two-high shell where the cornerback reads the #2 slot receiver and aggressively jumps the out-route while safety carries #1 deep
